biological_replicate: graft unions at 0 d and 7 d after grafting

Plant samples were collected from the graft unions, including the cutting surfaces of the rootstocks (2 years old) and scions (1 year old), at 7 d after grafting. The samples from graft unions at the first day of grafting were used as the controls.
experimental_design: comparison of two grafting stages (0 d vs 7 d after grafting)
Comparison of two grafting stages of Chinese hickory revealed that the differential expressed succinylated proteins were mainly involved in sugar metabolism
factor_value: at 7 d after grafting as compared with the control (0 d after grafting)
